title: API-503 connection pool exhausted
text: For API-503 connection pool exhausted on version 2.0, check active connections and increase the pool limit only after confirming database capacity.

title: API-503 connection pool exhausted
text: For API-503 on version 1.0, restart the connection manager after inspecting active connections.

title: Login MFA clock drift
text: For login MFA clock drift, synchronize the device clock and retry the one-time code.
